entities.summary: Edan Lui Cheuk-on, is a Hong Kong idol, singer, actor, presenter, and a member of the Hong Kong boy group Mirror. Apart from his group activities, Edan made his solo debut in 2021 and has presented various television variety shows such as Be ON Game, and starred in television dramas, most notably Ossan's Love (2021), as well as several feature films, including Chilli Laugh Story and Hong Kong Family.
